document.name: SignInSignUp
document.purpose: One screen on which a returning or a new person signs in or signs up, with an email address or with Google or GitHub.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.doc: Which form is showing; the container sets the one the screen opens on.

inputs.name: onModeChange
inputs.doc: Called when the person chooses the other form.

inputs.name: fullName
inputs.doc: Sign-up name field value.

inputs.name: email
inputs.doc: Email field value, shared by both forms.

inputs.name: password
inputs.doc: Password field value, shared by both forms.

inputs.name: pending
inputs.doc: True while a submission or provider sign-in is in flight; blocks a second send.

inputs.name: errorNotice
inputs.doc: The notice for a rejected sign-in or sign-up (an Alert, tone danger, that does not say whether the email or the password was wrong), or null when there is none.

inputs.name: onSignIn
inputs.doc: Submits the sign-in form. The container prevents the native form submission.

inputs.name: onSignUp
inputs.doc: Submits the sign-up form. The container prevents the native form submission.

inputs.name: onGoogle
inputs.doc: Starts sign-in with Google.

inputs.name: onGitHub
inputs.doc: Starts sign-in with GitHub.

inputs.name: resetHref
inputs.doc: Where the password reset flow lives.

inputs.name: onNavigate
inputs.doc: The app's router.

props.title: Welcome
props.description: Sign in to your account, or create one.

document.name: DeploymentAssistant
document.purpose: A conversation with an assistant about a deployment, with tool calls, in-thread approval before a restart, and a composer that sends or stops.

inputs.name: turns
inputs.doc: The conversation's turns, oldest first, as ChatMessage elements (user and assistant), each assistant turn holding its ToolCall rows and any ApprovalCard. Empty or absent when there are none.

inputs.name: streaming
inputs.doc: True while a reply is arriving.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.doc: The message being written.

inputs.name: onStop
inputs.doc: Stops the reply that is arriving.

inputs.name: attachments
inputs.doc: Files attached to the draft.

props.title: Deployment assistant
props.description: Ask about your deployment. The assistant asks before it restarts anything.

props.title: Ask about your deployment
props.description: I can read your service logs to find out what went wrong, and restart a service once you allow it.

document.name: UsageOverview
document.purpose: Shows a team lead how much of the plan the team has used this period, with headline numbers, a daily requests chart, a period switch and a usage download.

inputs.name: stats
inputs.doc: The four headline stats (requests, error rate, median latency, seats used of bought), already formatted, each with a delta carrying direction and whether it is good. While loading the container supplies placeholder values so the row keeps its shape.

inputs.name: daily
inputs.doc: Requests per day across the period: { date: ISO date string, requests: number }.

inputs.name: period
inputs.doc: The selected period: 'this-month' or 'last-month'.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.doc: True while the numbers load.

inputs.name: onDownload
inputs.doc: Downloads the period's usage as a file.

props.title: Usage overview
props.description: How much of your plan the team has used this period.

document.name: OrderPage
document.purpose: A support agent's view of one order: its status, facts, history, team comments and a confirmed refund.

inputs.name: order
inputs.doc: The order: number, status label, customer, placed date, total, payment method, shipping address, all as display strings.

inputs.name: statusTone
inputs.doc: Badge tone for the order's current status (paid, shipped, delivered, refunded).

inputs.name: events
inputs.doc: Order events, newest first; each title says what happened, time is pre-formatted, detail names who did it.

inputs.name: comments
inputs.doc: CommentThread.Comment elements for the support team's comments, one per comment with author, avatar and RelativeTime.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.doc: The text of the comment being written.

inputs.name: refundDescription
inputs.doc: Consequence text for the refund, stating the amount being refunded.

inputs.name: refundConfirmLabel
inputs.doc: Confirm verb including the amount, e.g. 'Refund $42.00'.

inputs.name: refundDisabled
inputs.doc: True when the order cannot be refunded, e.g. already refunded.

inputs.name: posting
inputs.doc: True while a comment is being posted.

inputs.name: onBack
inputs.doc: Return to the list of orders.

inputs.name: onRefund
inputs.doc: Issue the refund once confirmed.

inputs.name: onDraftChange
inputs.doc: Draft comment edited.

inputs.name: onPostComment
inputs.doc: Post the draft comment.

document.name: BookRoomScreen
document.purpose: Lets an employee book a meeting room for a team discussion, validating on submit and reporting every problem beside its field and in a summary.

inputs.name: rooms
inputs.doc: The known list of rooms, as Select options.

inputs.name: durationOptions
inputs.doc: The 30, 60 and 90 minute choices, as RadioGroup options.

inputs.name: room
inputs.doc: Selected room value.

inputs.name: date
inputs.doc: Selected date.

inputs.name: minDate
inputs.doc: Today; earlier dates cannot be chosen.

inputs.name: startTime
inputs.doc: Selected start time.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.doc: Selected length in minutes, as a string value.

inputs.name: invitees
inputs.doc: Email addresses invited.

inputs.name: note
inputs.doc: Optional note for the invitation.

inputs.name: fieldErrors
inputs.doc: Per-field error text after a failed submit; a field without an error is undefined.

inputs.name: summaryErrors
inputs.doc: Every error in form order, each with the id of its field; empty when valid.

inputs.name: submitting
inputs.doc: True while the booking is being made.

inputs.name: onSubmit
inputs.doc: Validates and books the room; the container ignores it while submitting.

inputs.name: onCancel
inputs.doc: Leaves the screen without booking.

props.title: Book a room
props.description: Choose a room and time, then invite the people who should come.

props.title: The room can't be booked yet

props.label: People invited
props.description: Type an email address and press Enter.

document.name: IncidentsScreen
document.purpose: Lets an on-call engineer triage incidents: search, filter, sort by opening time, and delete one after a named confirmation.

inputs.name: incidents
inputs.doc: The incidents matching the current search and filters, already ordered by the container.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.doc: Title, service, severity, status, opened (sortable, RelativeTime) and a delete action that calls onRequestDelete with the row.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.doc: Current sort; newest-opened first by default.

inputs.name: search
inputs.doc: Current title search text.

inputs.name: severity
inputs.doc: Selected severity, null for all.

inputs.name: status
inputs.doc: Selected state (open or resolved), null for all.

inputs.name: isFiltered
inputs.doc: True while a search or any filter is set.

inputs.name: resultCount
inputs.doc: How many incidents match.

inputs.name: onClearFilters
inputs.doc: Clears the search and every filter at once.

inputs.name: hasNoIncidents
inputs.doc: True when there are no incidents at all, filters aside.

inputs.name: deleteOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the delete confirmation is showing.

inputs.name: deleteTitle
inputs.doc: The question, naming the incident, e.g. Delete “Checkout latency spike”?

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: The consequence, naming the incident and saying it cannot be undone.

inputs.name: onConfirmDelete
inputs.doc: Deletes the incident the container holds as pending.

props.title: Incidents
props.description: Incidents raised by your services, newest first.

$object.title: No incidents
$object.description: None of your services has raised an incident. New ones will appear here.

$object.title: No incidents match
$object.description: Nothing fits the current search and filters. Widen them or clear them all.

document.name: OnboardingProfileStep
document.purpose: The profile step of account setup: name, role and an optional photo, with the four setup steps shown and a way to leave and finish later.

inputs.name: activeIndex
inputs.doc: 0-based index of the current setup step; steps before it are finished.

inputs.name: name
inputs.doc: The name entered so far.

inputs.name: role
inputs.doc: The chosen role value, or null.

inputs.name: roleOptions
inputs.doc: The short list of roles to choose from.

inputs.name: photoFiles
inputs.doc: The photo file rows, owned by the container.

inputs.name: continueDisabled
inputs.doc: True until both the name and the role are filled in.

inputs.name: onSaveForLater
inputs.doc: Leaves setup, keeping everything entered.

props.title: Set up your profile
props.description: Tell us a little about yourself. You can change this later.

props.title: Drop a photo or click to browse

document.name: WorkspaceSettings
document.purpose: Lets a workspace owner change how the workspace behaves for everyone in it, with every change applied immediately, and guards ownership transfer and deletion in a danger zone.

inputs.name: workspaceName
inputs.doc: Current workspace name.

inputs.name: onWorkspaceNameChange
inputs.doc: Applies the new name at once.

inputs.name: timeZone
inputs.doc: Selected IANA time zone id.

inputs.name: timeZoneOptions
inputs.doc: Time zones to choose from, as { value, label }.

inputs.name: digestEnabled
inputs.doc: Whether members get an email digest.

inputs.name: digestDisabled
inputs.doc: True while the digest is off, so its frequency cannot be changed.

inputs.name: digestFrequency
inputs.doc: daily or weekly.

inputs.name: digestFrequencyOptions
inputs.doc: Daily and weekly.

inputs.name: membersMayInvite
inputs.doc: Whether members may invite other people.

inputs.name: transferOpen
inputs.doc: Whether the transfer dialog is open.

inputs.name: onTransferCancel
inputs.doc: Closes the transfer dialog without transferring.

inputs.name: memberOptions
inputs.doc: Other members who could become owner, as { value, label }.

inputs.name: newOwnerId
inputs.doc: The member chosen to receive ownership.

inputs.name: transferBlocked
inputs.doc: True until a member is chosen.

inputs.name: deleteDescription
inputs.doc: Names the workspace, says deletion is irreversible and that every project in it is deleted too.

props.title: Workspace settings
props.description: Changes apply for everyone in the workspace as soon as you make them.

props.label: Workspace name
props.description: The name members see across the workspace.

props.label: Time zone
props.description: The time zone every date in the workspace is shown in.

props.label: Email digest
props.description: Sends members a summary of workspace activity by email.

props.label: Digest frequency
props.description: How often the email digest is sent: daily or weekly.

props.label: Members can invite
props.description: Lets any member invite other people to the workspace.

props.label: Transfer ownership
props.description: Hands ownership of the workspace to another member.

props.title: Transfer ownership
props.description: Choose the member who will become the owner. You will no longer own this workspace.

props.label: Delete workspace
props.description: Permanently deletes the workspace and every project in it. This cannot be undone.
